options.content:
## What lives where

**Overview** — KPIs, request rate, host gauges, recent 5xx logs. *First glance.*

**HTTP Traffic** — Top routers/services, latency heatmap, status-code stack, bandwidth. *Traffic shape.*

**Backends** — Per-service open connections, retries, latency matrix, recent errors. *Which backend is misbehaving?*

**TLS & Certificates** — All certs sorted by expiry, ACME activity log. *Renewal planning.*

**Alerts** — Currently firing alerts, alert history, rule-eval health, silences. *First stop on a page.*

**SLI / SLO** — Availability, p95 latency, error-budget burn (multi-window). *SLO compliance review.*

**Resource Monitor** — Per-container CPU / RAM / network / disk IOPS ranked against host capacity. *Who is loading the box?*

**Process Detail** — Per-process CPU / RAM / disk I/O / threads / file descriptors (process-exporter). *Which process inside the container?*

**Containers** — Per-container CPU/Mem/Net/IO, restarts, OOM events. *Resource health.*

**Client Analysis** — Top source IPs, abuse signals, probe-pattern hits. *Defensive triage.*

**Logs Explorer** — Free-form Loki search across all containers. *Open-ended investigation.*

**Self-Monitoring** — Prometheus/Loki internals, scrape-pool health, cardinality trend. *Monitoring of monitoring.*
